en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views of a rural settlement. The upper, wider image shows a panoramic view of a village behind open fields, labeled "Total-Ansicht." The lower left inset shows a two‑storey inn building with several people standing outside; the sign text names it as an inn (Gasthof). On the right side there is a blank area for writing, printed with a greeting from Raum near Schweizmühle and the printer's imprint at the bottom.
